approval.scope: P8 implementation and the bounded local measurement below
approval.plan_hash_rule: Hash the approval-commit blob, even after the living plan status changes.

questions.question: Are family answers rejection-aware?
required: total, accepted and rejected row counts
questions.boundary: Accepted-only stability cannot establish stability of the whole family.

questions.question: Does the submitted witness warrant its claim throughout the family?
questions.boundary: Alternative claim support cannot rescue the submitted witness.

questions.question: Which choices change an observable?
required: same-history single and joint slot minima
questions.boundary: Answers apply to the declared reference and finite family.

questions.question: Which conditional facts suffice?
required: a deletion countercompletion for each member
questions.boundary: Restrictions must be nonempty, rejection-free and satisfy the requested accepted target.

questions.question: What does a source edit change?
required: full before and after public statuses
questions.boundary: Failed locality does not imply changed status.

questions.question: What can a snapshot-only report hide?
required: projection of the same captured public-status rows
family, audit, assumption and transition contrasts
questions.boundary: This compares diagnostic visibility and cannot measure agent success.

questions.question: Are these bounded workloads operationally feasible?
questions.boundary: One local run provides descriptive costs without speedup or asymptotic claims.

case_matrix.criterion: Compare the accepted endpoint with itself.
Compare the rejected endpoint with itself.
Keep both endpoints blocked; the conditional label changes from defeated to justified and the full status changes.
Keep the queried status defeated with successful locality despite an unrelated edit.
Edit inside the query ancestry while retaining its status and failing sufficient locality.
Permute declarations with stable identity correspondence and fixed query; require equal statuses and successful locality.
Use a nonempty family with equal rejection outcomes; retain the frozen empty-accepted-domain rule and an unreachable published justified target.
Keep accepted claim status equal while the fixed-witness audit changes; the catalog selects the passing row.
Add a third choice with an existing flip set; keep every differing row, deduplicate minima and retain the first declaration-order realizer.
Request reference and joint slot sensitivity; require a joint minimum without a singleton minimum.
Use an unreachable accepted target and contradictory slot equality/inequality; no subset, including an empty restriction, can satisfy it.
All rows satisfy the accepted target; irrelevant literals leave only the empty minimal set.
An observed witness passes only with the exact admitted source/process/capture binding.
Generate and verify a sanctioned certificate, then alter one read value within its original value type; require verified and invalid-certificate.

recipes.structural_encoding: scripts/evidence_measured.py parse/canonical; source edits must be structural

axes.construction: Add inert singleton slots only; preserve histories, row observables and sensitive original slots.

Add disconnected accepted leaf-root groups, each with one fresh leaf, one fresh root argument, fresh atom and required signature entry, to both endpoints. Record the exact AST declaration charge separately.
Add distinct unused-slot inequalities true in every row to one explicit minimal-assumptions request; do not add new minima.

Repeat only the wrapper request list with fresh labels; charge work cumulatively per document. Every level stays below every declared limit (at most 352 of 1000 pairs), so no case expects a refusal and the refusal count is zero by construction.

order.generated_variants: axis list order, then seed list order, then numeric level list order
order.requests: original declaration order; generated repeated labels must be unique
order.driver_first: native at zero-based even manifest positions; Lean at odd positions

recipes.empty_changed_set_rule: Use the frozen inquiry semantics; an empty changed partition does not establish equality of rejection payloads.
recipes.unused_slot_inequality_rule: Fresh undeclared slot inequalities are true because selectionFor returns no choice; annotate every predicate value.
recipes.duplicates: Disclose duplicate input hashes and exclude them from unique-semantic-input denominators. Variants remain correlated with their seeds.

ceilings.effective_cap_rule: Use min(declared cap, frozen checker ceiling); histories also honor the embedded completion cap.
ceilings.charging_rule: Charge repeated requests cumulatively per document. These ceilings are hard bounds, not performance targets.

budget.failure_policy: Timeout, signal, spawn/consumer failure, resource kill or aggregate deadline exhaustion makes the run incomplete. Retain all partial captures and missing cases, stop, and obtain an approved protocol/budget revision before another final run.
budget.expected_refusal_policy: Retain expected limit refusals with exact counter, actual/cap and atomic output; distinguish them from source rejection and infrastructure failure.

requirements: enumerate bounded histories and surviving selections
annotate endpoint graphs and rejection payloads
full public statuses and fixed-witness audit
complete reference flips and slot minima
all catalog subsets and deletion countercompletions
support correspondence, ancestry, new attackers and equal blocking
oracle_policy.controls: Existing goldens provide disclosed development conformance controls; they do not become independent new semantic evidence.

freeze.input_commit_rule: Commit reviewed candidate first; approval binds that existing commit and exact candidate protocol SHA256. Metadata-only freeze commit follows if authorized. Pass the final committed input identity as --input-commit; never write a commit hash into its own bytes.
freeze.manifest_hash_rule: After independent input review, hash the final MANIFEST.json bytes into protocol.json before measurement. MANIFEST.json must not hash protocol.json.

legacy_inputs.inventory_recipe: git ls-tree -rz CODE_COMMIT -- TREE supplies tracked blobs. For each blob, emit {"path": repository-relative POSIX path, "sha256": lowercase SHA256 of current file bytes (symlink target bytes for mode 120000)}. Sort records by path, encode the array as JSON with sort_keys=True, separators=(comma,colon), ensure_ascii=False plus LF, then SHA256. Gitlinks are separately pinned to their clean checkout commit and Git tree.

setup.scope: Dependency verification only; setup and correctness gates stay outside measurement.

native_dependency_check.result: Only the local lara library and executable need rebuilding; no missing external dependency was reported.

claim_limits: Authored finite inputs do not estimate prevalence in real research artifacts.
Modeled capture admissions do not establish physical capture.
Hypothetical choices never acquire observed assurance.
Equal full status does not transport process entitlement.
Snapshot comparison cannot establish agent success or discovery improvement.
Statistical profiles, real origin-sensitive corroboration, causal identification and infinite-horizon guarantees remain outside P8.

p9.decision_rule: Review the complete immutable P8 report and apply the approved P9 decision table before choosing a separately specified and budgeted live protocol.

amendments.approval_source: explicit response to the source-axis clarification question before input freeze and measurement
amendments.approval_text: Count leaf-root groups; clarify the protocol accordingly (Recommended)
amendments.interpretation: Source-declarations levels 0, 1, 4, 16 count fresh leaf-root groups. Each group adds one leaf and one root argument, hence 0, 2, 8, 32 AST declarations per endpoint.

Clone the after policy rule r-s as r-s-new. Only new-attacker references r-s-new. Both rules retain the seed premise and s conclusion. Four distinct support terms yield two unattacked attackers, defeated witness/consumer, unchanged defeated query, failed locality. Repair only T07 and its four source-declaration variants; original freeze and expectations stay byte-identical.
amendments.approval_location: correction_approval receipt approved_amendments: one entry with this id, a non-blank researcher approval_text string and interpretation_sha256, the SHA256 of this interpretation in UTF-8. The loader refuses a receipt without it.

data_policy.input_origin: repository fixtures and authored synthetic inputs only
data_policy.retention: retain the original failed attempt and every new outcome; files are retained for the requested implementation PR
data_policy.approval_location: correction_approval receipt data_policy_sha256: the SHA256 of this object encoded by json_bytes (sorted keys, separators "," and ":", ensure_ascii false, UTF-8, one trailing LF). The loader refuses a receipt without it.
data_policy.repository_cost: Capture, replay and preflight directories are committed. The failed attempt took about 62 MB per capture or replay directory in the working tree, including a 42 MB gzipped Lean binary. The two directories share identical binaries, so with the 6 MB preflight directory they added about 68 MB of unique content to Git. A new run should add a similar amount.
